meta.title: About Five Foot Way | A Singapore travel planner
meta.description: Why we plan Singapore trips around neighbourhoods, hawker centres and the weather, and how we work with you.

hero.title: The shaded city
hero.sub: Why we named ourselves after a covered walkway.

statement.text: Five Foot Way plans trips to Singapore for travellers who want more than a skyline and a shopping street. We design days on foot, in the old neighbourhoods and the green places, around food, and around the city's heat and rain.

collage.title: Human-scale Singapore
collage.caption: Singapore is famous for its towers. We prefer the two-storey city: the shophouse terraces, the hawker halls, the village on Pulau Ubin and the paths through the forest. They are where the city is most generous to people on foot.
notes: We started Five Foot Way because the trips our friends were sold missed the things we love most about the city.
We are not a hotel, an airline or a tour bus. We plan, book and look after trips, and we are paid for that work, not by commissions that steer you to the wrong place.

principles.title: Neighbourhoods before attractions
text: One district a day, walked properly, beats five landmarks seen from a coach.

principles.title: Plan for the weather
text: Early starts, shaded routes, long lunches and a storm plan. Comfort is part of good travel, not a luxury.

principles.title: Eat where Singapore eats
text: Hawker centres first. They are the heart of the city's food, and they need visitors who behave like regulars.

principles.title: Honest advice
text: If your layover is too short, we will tell you to stay airside. If a place is crowded or overrated at the time you plan to go, we will say so.

how.title: You write to us
how.text: Through the [enquiry form](@enquire) or by email. Tell us your dates, who is travelling and what you enjoy.

how.title: We reply personally
how.text: Within two working days, by email, with questions and first ideas.

how.title: We send a plan
how.text: A day-by-day plan with neighbourhoods, walks, hawker centres and hotels, and a quote.

how.title: We book and look after it
how.text: Once you confirm, we make the bookings and send you a final guide before you travel.

bleed.title: Tell us about your trip
bleed.text: Dates, layover, interests, who is coming. We will reply by email.
